description: The BlockProver precompile call itself is unreachable -- distinct from the precompile executing and returning false (fake-merkle-proof.json). Models Attestcoin being down: fail closed, name it, never substitute a self-minted source (PRD invariant 6).
note: Real Gate 1 stream's fields, with precompileAvailable flipped to false. proofVerified is irrelevant here since the model must reject on precompileAvailable before ever looking at it.
